game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · General-purpose languages
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled iron keys but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Case 6: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about General-purpose languages.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Continue Gate' (Week 4 slot 11), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Dragon Hoard Cave'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.

source_player_objective: Reach the crystal door using at most 12 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The crystal door reached with actions_used <= 12.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 12 before the crystal door is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Continue Gate – Dragon Hoard Cave Trial
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
